description: NIP-CP pocket entries (kind 9525 rumors): bill and pending entries as tags (K-POCKET-1..2), rumor parsing refusals, version resolution (K-POCKET-3), the per-chain balance (K-POCKET-4), the cash_order pending entry and its close rule (K-POCKET-5), and the cash_withdraw pending entry with its receipt, source spent, done and rewrite (K-POCKET-6).

rumors.name: the done entry that closes it
a cash_order entry with secret and notify
a cash_order entry with order_key and notify
a cash_order entry without notify
rumors.error: nipCP: malformed pocket entry: a cash_order entry keeps its notify, and its secret or order_key

parseRumor.name: rev 07
parseRumor.error: nipCP: malformed pocket entry: rev: "07" is not a canonical unsigned integer

parseRumor.name: amount +21000
parseRumor.error: nipCP: malformed pocket entry: amount: "+21000" is not a canonical unsigned integer

parseRumor.name: amount 21000.0
parseRumor.error: nipCP: malformed pocket entry: amount: "21000.0" is not a canonical unsigned integer

parseRumor.name: uppercase w
parseRumor.error: nipCP: malformed pocket entry: w or rev

parseRumor.name: 64-hex mint
parseRumor.error: nipCP: malformed pocket entry: mint is a 66-hex compressed pubkey

parseRumor.name: no state time
parseRumor.error: nipCP: malformed pocket entry: state needs its check time

parseRumor.name: two amounts
parseRumor.error: nipCP: malformed pocket entry: two "amount" tags

parseRumor.error: nipCP: malformed pocket entry: expires_at 0 means never and is not stored
